rule: Computed only from registered official numbers. n is printed on every value. Anything without an official source is blank and named, never assumed to be zero.

publisher_source.role: closing spread and total, both clubs per game

result_source.role: final scores used for every outcome

sign_convention: A line is written from the favoured side as a negative number. So a home line of -7 means the home club is favoured by a touchdown, and the expected home margin is +7. That makes the EXPECTED correlation between the signed home line and the home margin NEGATIVE, and between the closing total and the actual total POSITIVE. A coefficient with the opposite sign to this convention would mean the number is pointing the wrong way, not that the forecast is strong.

market_line_vs_actual_margin.risk_note: Nominal interval; assumes independent pairs, which division games violate.
market_line_vs_actual_margin.pair: published closing home line ~ actual home margin
market_line_vs_actual_margin.kind: market benchmark; this is how good the price itself is

market_total_vs_actual_total.risk_note: Nominal interval; assumes independent pairs, which division games violate.
market_total_vs_actual_total.pair: published closing total ~ actual game total
market_total_vs_actual_total.kind: market benchmark; this is how good the price itself is

market_line_vs_market_total.risk_note: Nominal interval; assumes independent pairs, which division games violate.

home_cover_vs_over.note: Joint frequency of home-cover and over on the published closing numbers.
home_cover_vs_over.kind: leg dependence for a two-leg parlay

fair_line_vs_actual_margin.risk_note: Nominal interval; assumes independent pairs, which division games violate.
fair_line_vs_actual_margin.pair: our fair line ~ actual home margin

fair_total_vs_actual_total.risk_note: Nominal interval; assumes independent pairs, which division games violate.
fair_total_vs_actual_total.pair: our fair total ~ actual game total

not_measured.quantity: Correlation between two player props in the same game
not_measured.why_blank: No published player price exists in the store, so the numbers behind the dependence are not official numbers this project holds.
not_measured.do_not_assume: Not zero. Treating it as zero would misprice every same-game combination. The correct state is 'unpriced'.
not_measured.what_would_close_it: A licensed feed with player prices for enough games to estimate the joint distribution, plus a rights decision.

not_measured.quantity: Correlation between the side and the moneyline
not_measured.why_blank: The moneyline is derived from the same margin distribution as the side, so they are functionally dependent by construction. A correlation coefficient on two derived views of one number would be an artefact, not a finding.
not_measured.do_not_assume: Do not quote a coefficient for it. State the functional dependence instead.
not_measured.what_would_close_it: Nothing: it is dependent by definition, not an empirical question.

not_measured.quantity: Team-level season correlations carried over from the earlier work
not_measured.why_blank: Those are club-season aggregates across teams, a different quantity from the dependence between two legs of one bet. Mixing them would be a category error.
not_measured.do_not_assume: Do not substitute a team-season correlation for a leg dependence.
not_measured.what_would_close_it: Nothing needed; they answer a different question.
